title: Mythological
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic|image=Mythological Mob Type Icon.png|label1=Type|data1=[[Mob Type]]}}
{{MobType|Mythological}} is a [[Mob Type]] for mobs that are found exclusively during the [[Mythological Ritual]]. They spawn when excavating [[Griffin Burrows]] with an {{Item|Ancestral Spade|text=Ancestral}}, {{Item|Archaic Spade|text=Archaic}}, and {{Item|Deific Spade}}.

== Behavior ==
{{MobType|Mythological}} mobs have a {{Green|75%}} chance to spawn from any [[Griffin Burrow]] in a chain except for the first one, and require a matching or higher tier of {{Item|Griffin Pet}} as the one they were spawned with to damage. They despawn after five minutes if they are not killed, or if the player who spawned them dies.
